source.title: Income estimates for small areas, England and Wales: financial year ending 2023
source.period: Financial year ending March 2023 (1 April 2022 to 31 March 2023)
source.geography: Middle layer Super Output Areas, Census 2021 (7,264 MSOAs, England and Wales)
source.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (Source: Office for National Statistics)

measures.total_annual_income: Model-based estimate of mean total (gross) annual household income, £, sheet 'Total annual income'
measures.net_income_ahc: Model-based estimate of mean disposable (net) annual household income, equivalised, after housing costs, £, sheet 'Net income after housing costs'

caveats: Model-based point-in-time estimates; ONS advises caution comparing with earlier editions (FYE 2020 used 2011 MSOAs).
Confidence limits reflect sampling uncertainty only.
No estimates exist for FYE 2021 or FYE 2022 (pandemic).
